http/internal/http2_flow#

HTTP/2 flow control (RFC 9113 §5.2): window accounting for the connection and each stream, DATA payloads and WINDOW_UPDATE frames.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

HTTP/2 flow control (RFC 9113 §5.2): window accounting for the connection and each stream, DATA payloads and WINDOW_UPDATE frames.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object Http2FlowWindow#

object Http2FlowWindow

Pure window accounting, not an async scheduler. Connection owns the two directional window sets and publishes immutable successors under its reader.

The window of stream (0 for the connection) with remaining bytes.

object Http2SendCredit#

object Http2SendCredit

Sender reservation is atomic data publication under the owning scheduler. Receiving deliberately has no all-or-nothing pair: valid connection charge must survive a stream error until the discarded bytes are credited back.
